definitions.explanation: a set of pre-purchased tickets sold at a discount, typically for trains, buses, or repeated services

examples.japanese: {回数券|かいすうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: To buy a book of tickets.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回数券|かいすうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧11{枚綴|まいつづ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧10{枚分|まいぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧だ。
examples.english: Bus ticket books come with 11 tickets for the price of 10.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回数券|かいすうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}った→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧。
examples.english: I used up all my salon coupon tickets.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧ (number of times) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket)

- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回数券|かいすうけん} (train ticket book)
- ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回数券|かいすうけん} (bus ticket book)
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回数券|かいすうけん} (parking coupon book)
- ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧・⟦{整体|せいたい}→整体：27407_seitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{回数券|かいすうけん} (salon/massage coupon book)

USAGE:
With the spread of IC cards like Suica and PASMO, physical {回数券|かいすうけん} for public transport have become less common in major cities.
